title: Currywurst Wrap
description: A fusion of German and Southeast Asian flavors, this Currywurst Wrap is a delicious twist on the classic street food.

ingredients.name: Zesty Chicken Sausage
ingredients.notes: Grill or cook in a pan until browned

instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill or cook the Zesty Chicken Sausage until browned, about 5 minutes.
Warm the Chickpea Wrap in the microwave or oven for a few seconds.
Spread the Malaysian Curry Sauce on the warmed wrap.
Add the cooked sausage, chopped onions, and chopped cilantro to the wrap.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
